title: Từ chỉ loại và chỉ định: measure words and pointing

segments.script: [EN: Quick review. Older man —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: anh] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Older woman —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: chị] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Younger person —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: em] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Six —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: sáu] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Seven —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: bảy] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Eight —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: tám] [EN: Good.]

The pattern is number, then a counting word, called a measure word. You already know the numbers — today you get five measure words, plus two words for pointing: this, and that.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: The first is] [VI: cái] [EN: a general word for counting objects. Add them after] [VI: cái] [EN: to mean this one, or that one.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI: này] [EN: means this. It has] [EN: a falling tone] [EN: — falling. And to count something, say the number, then the measure word:] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: hai ly] [EN: two glasses.]
